question: 'Ras-Lila' recognised as one of the classical dance forms of India belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ras-Lila** is a **traditional dance** form of **Manipur.**
 
• Ras-Lila is a form of classical dance that depicts the love story of **Lord Krishna and Radha.**
 
• The dance form is performed by both **male and female dancers** wearing traditional Manipuri attire.
 
• The dance is accompanied by traditional Manipuri music and instruments like **pung, pena, and harmonium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur** is also known for other traditional dance forms like **Nata Sankirtana, Thang-Ta, and Pung Cholom.**
 
• **Assam's Bihu dance **is a celebration of the** harvest season** and is performed by both men and women.
 
• **Meghalaya's Nongkrem dance** is a part of the annual Nongkrem festival and is performed by the** Khasi tribe.**
 
• **Tripura's Hozagiri dance **is performed by the** Reang tribe** and is a part of their harvest festival.
